description: This file defines the interface class DobbyInterface for managing container lifecycle and related operations within the WPEFramework plugin system. It declares methods for starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and querying containers, as well as handling container events and annotations.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: Class providing container management and event handling functionalities using Dobby proxy within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the interface with an event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up the interface resources.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Retrieves list of current containers.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about a specific container.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Fetches the current state of a container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified parameters.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a container, optionally forcing shutdown.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses the container's activity.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: hibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates the container with specific options.

methods.name: wakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command in a container.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to a container.

methods.name: removeAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation from a container.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem source into the container.

methods.name: unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem from the container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Event handler for container start event.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Event handler for container stop event.

methods.name: onContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Event handler for container state change.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Handles container verification failure.

ctags.name: mEventListenerId
ctags.pattern: /^            int mEventListenerId; \/\/ Dobby event listener ID$/
